l: Active - Infernal Chains: Pulls 2/2/5 of the farthest enemies toward himself, then slams the ground in front of himself, dealing 250/450/1250 magic damage to all enemies hit.
Base attack speed increased to 0.8 from 0.75.
New Effect: Ability is now an actual channel that can be interrupted (i.e. stun, Guardian Angel) causing her to release her orb early and reducing the size of the impact area.
Active - Spirit Bomb: Begins channeling energy into her spirit orb. After 1.5 seconds she lobs it toward a random enemy, dealing 500/800/4000 magic damage to all enemies in a large area.
Base attack speed increased to 0.85 from 0.75.
Mana lock after spell cast increased to 1.25 seconds from 1.
Active - Five Point Strike: Throws kunai at her target, dealing 150/225/400 magic damage.
Active - Burst Shield: Blasts a cone of fire dealing 200/300/450 magic damage to enemies in front of her, then shields herself for 400/600/900 health for 8 seconds.
Base attack damage reduced to 45 from 50.
Base attack damage increased to 50 from 45.
Removed: Turret no longer grants mana and applies on-attack effects, but still triggers on-hit effects.
Base attack speed increased to 0.75 from 0.7.
New Effect: Turrets now stop firing when he is disabled.
Ability duration increased to 7/8/9/11 seconds from 6/7/8/11.

Active - Sentry Turret: Summons a turret for 6/7/8/11 seconds. An extension of his will, the turret counts as Aphelios himself when it fires and deals damage, and dies when he dies. Turrets can keep attacking while Aphelios is crowd-controlled. Turrets cannot be targeted by enemies. Turrets do not apply spell effects.
Ability bonus attack speed reduced to 45/65/300% from 50/75/300%.

Active - Hunter's Focus: For the next 5 seconds, gains 50/75/300% bonus attack speed, and basic attacks fire a flurry of five arrows dealing 45% AD physical damage per arrow, for a total of % AD physical damage. Each flurry is considered as one basic attack.

Active - Emperor's Divide: Calls forth a wall of charging soliders from behind him, dealing 200/350/2000 magic damage and slowing all enemies hit for 4 seconds. Enemies close to him are knocked back, while enemies further away are knocked up for 2 seconds.

Active - Petrifying Gaze: Projects a cone of magic energy at her target, dealing 275/400/2000 magic damage to all enemies hit, stunning them for 2.5/3/5 seconds, and causing them to take 10% increased damage while stunned.

Active - Pale Cascade: Shields herself against 200/300/450/650 damage over 4 seconds and summons 3/4/6/10 orbs to orbit around her. These orbs explode for 70/80/90/100 magic damage when they contact an enemy, refreshing her shield when the final one explodes.
Ability heal per basic attack increased to 40/80/160 from 40/80/120.
Active - Spider Form: Transforms into a spider, gaining 35/40/45% maximum health and causing her basic attacks to restore 40/80/120 health.
Maximum ability damage reduced to 350*2.5/600*2.5/1500*2.5 from 350*3/500*3/1400*3.
Active - Last Caress: Deals 350/500/900 magic damage to up to 3 nearby enemies, then teleports away. The damage is increased to 350*3/500*3/900*3 against targets below 50% health.

Active - Flux Barrage: Fires a barrage toward the enemy with the highest attack speed, healing allies it passes through for 250/450/9999 and granting them and 50% bonus attack speed for 5 seconds, while dealing 250/450/9999 magic damage to enemies and slowing their attack speed by 50% for 5 seconds.
Chosen Fiora now has 25% mana cost reduction instead of 400 bonus health.

Active - Riposte: Enters a defensive stance for 1.5 seconds, becoming immune to damage and enemy spell effects. Upon exiting the stance, deals 200/300/450 magic damage up to 3-hex range, stop at the first enemy hit, favoring her attack target, and stuns them for 1.5/2/3 seconds.
Active - Judgment: Spins his sword for 4 seconds, dealing 450/675/1125 magic damage to nearby enemies and reducing incoming magic damage by 80% over the duration.
Active - Spirit of Life: Creates an aura around him for 3 seconds. Each enemy within takes 250/400/600 magic damage, and heals him for 250/350/500 over the duration.
Active - Bladestorm: Launches a storm of blades in front of her, dealing 200/300/600 magic damage and disarming all enemies hit for 2.5/3/3.5 seconds.
Active - Eye of the Storm: Shields the 2/3/4 lowest-health allies for 250/300/400 for 4 seconds. Shielded allies gain 20/30/60 bonus attack damage for the duration.
Ability stun duration reduced to 1 second from 2.

Active - Dragon Strike: Throws his standard near the farthest enemy then pulls himself toward them with his lance, dealing 175/250/500 magic damage to enemies he passes through, knocking them up and stunning them for 2 seconds.
Base attack speed increased to 0.75 from 0.65.
Active - Counter Strike: Dodges all incoming basic attacks for 2 seconds, then strikes all nearby enemies, dealing 150/250/450 magic damage and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
Ability AD ratio reduced to 444/475/1234% AD from 444/500/1234% AD.
Base attack damage increased to 100 from 85.
Ability AD ratio reduced to 444/500/1234% AD from 444/500/4444% AD.

Passive - Whisper: Attacks 0.85/0.9/1.2 times per second, regardless of bonus attack speed. Converts every 1% bonus attack speed he has into 0.8 bonus attack damage. Additionally, every fourth basic attack deals 444/500/4444% AD physical damage.
Ability stun duration increased to 1.5/2/2.5 seconds from 1.5 at all Star levels.
New Effect: Now stuns all targets in a 1 hex radius instead of just the target.
Chosen Jinx now has 25% mana cost reduction instead of 30% spell power.
Ability is now an actual spell instead of an auto-attack override.
Active - Fishbones: Fires a rocket, stunning her target for 1.5 seconds and dealing 200/325/550 magic damage to her target and all adjacent enemies.
Base attack speed reduced to 0.9 from 1.
Ability damage increased to 4/6/9% of target's maximum health from 4/6/8%.
Passive - Rend: Spears remain in her target, each one capable of dealing 4/6/8% of target's maximum health magic damage when removed. She removes the spears when doing so would kill the target.
Active - Death Lotus: Channels for 2.5 seconds, throwing knives at 4/6/8 nearby enemies, dealing 600/900/1600 magic damage over the duration and applying Grievous Wounds on them for 5 seconds.
Ability targeting has been adjusted to find valid targets to spin towards.
Shadow Assassin damage increase reduced to 50% from 75%.

Active - Reaping Slash: Dashes towards his target then slashes all adjacent enemies, dealing 450/600/6666 magic damage and increasing the cost of their next spell by 33%. If the slash hits exactly one target, he immediately casts again.
Rhaast: Heals for 50% of the damage dealt by the spell.
Shadow Assassin: Deals an additional 75% damage for the first 10 seconds of combat.
Base magic resistance increased to 30 from 20.

Active - Slicing Maelstrom: Summons a storm around him for 3 seconds, calling down lightning bolts on all enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds and dealing 300/450/900 magic damage over the duration. Each enemy struck by 3 lightning bolts is stunned for 1.5 seconds.
Active - Dance of Dread: Wolf mauls their target, dealing 450/650/1000 magic damage and applying Grievous Wounds to their target for 5 seconds, while Lamb leaps away from their target.
Base magic resistance increased to 60 from 50.
Ability stun duration increased to 2/3/10 seconds from 1.5/2/10.
Secondary target stun duration reduced to 1/2/10 seconds from 1.5/2/10.
New Effect: At 3 Stars, Lee Sin's knockout punch hits in an area around the primary target and knocks out any enemies directly hit regardless of their board position.
Ability stun duration reduced to 1.5/2/10 seconds from 3/4/10.
Secondary target stun duration increased to 1.5/2/10 from 1.5/1.5/10.

Active - God Fist: Punches his target, dealing 250/450/1000 magic damage, knocking them back to the edge of the battlefield, and stunning them for 3/4/10 seconds. Any enemies the target collides with during the knockback are also dealt half the damage and stunned for 1.5/1.5/10 seconds. If the target cannot be pushed any further, they are knocked out of the battlefield instead, removing them from combat. If the target is still alive, he will dash to them.
Ability break sleep damage reduced to 500 at all Star-levels from 500/750/1000.
Ability sleep duration changed to 3/4/8 seconds from 3.5/3.5/8.

Active - Lilting Lullaby: Casts a magical lullaby, causing 2/3/10 waking enemies with the highest current health to fall asleep for 3.5/3.5/8 seconds. Enemies will awaken if they take 500/750/1000 damage while sleeping, dealing 500/750/5000 bonus magic damage to them.
Ability now prioritizes the champion with the highest AD, instead of her current target.
Ability secondary damage increased to 175/225/300/450 from 150/200/300/450.

Active - 1000 Daggers: Hurls a dagger towards her target, dealing 300/400/600/900 magic damage to the first target it hits. After hitting its initial target or at its final destination, the dagger explodes dealing 150/200/300/450 magic damage to nearby targets.
Ability knock up duration reduced to 1 second from 1.5.
New Effect: Allies are now giants until the end of combat instead of for 6 seconds.

Active - Wild Growth: Makes a low health ally giant, granting them 400/600/950 bonus health and knocking up enemies near them for 1.5 seconds. Casting the spell multiple times on the same target does not stack the bonus health.
Chosen Lux now has 30% spell power instead of 25% mana cost reduction.
Active - Light Binding: Fires a sphere of light towards the farthest enemy. Enemies in the sphere's path take 300/400/700 magic damage and are stunned for 1.5/2/3 seconds.
Base magic resistance increased to 30 from 20.
Active - Bramble Smash: Smashes the ground sending forward a shockwave, dealing 225/350/550 magic damage and slowing their attack speed by 50% for 3 seconds.
Attack range reduced to 2 hexes from 3.
Updated her ability targeting to be slightly less random.

Active - Tormented Shadow: Hallows the ground beneath her target, dealing 250/400/2000 magic damage to enemies within over 5 seconds and reducing enemies' magic resistance by 40% while they remain inside. Also heals for 20/25/30% the damage dealt.
Ability stun duration increased to 2.5/3/4 seconds from 2/2.5/3.
Active - Aqua Prison: Traps the closest enemy in a bubble, dealing 225/325/450 magic damage and stunning them for 2/2.5/3 seconds.
Ability damage amplifier per hex increased to 20% from 10%.
Active - Javelin Toss: Throws her javelin at the farthest enemy, dealing 225/350/600 magic damage. This damage is increased by 10% for each per hex traveled.

Active - Consume: Willump bites his target, dealing 450/650/1300 magic damage. If the target has less current health than he does before the bite, it deals an additional 50% damage and deals true damage instead.

Active - Phantom Undertow: Leaves a phantom at his location, then dashes behind the farthest enemy. After 1 second, his phantom returns to him, dealing 150/250/450 magic damage to all enemies it passes through and stunning them for 2/2.5/4 seconds.
Ability wave damage reduced to 300/450/1350 from 300/450/1500.
Ability wave damage reduced to 300/450/1500 from 300/450/2000.

Active - Sweeping Strikes: Dashes and shields herself for 175/250/1000 health, then slashes forward dealing 175/250/1000 magic damage to nearby enemies. Every third cast, leaps into the air and launches a wave of energy that deals 300/450/2000 magic damage.

Active - Firecracker: Throws a giant firecracker at the enemy she is currently attacking, that explodes after a 2-second delay. Enemies within receive 100/200/800 magic damage and are stunned for 2.5/3/6 seconds.
Ability primary damage increased to 40/60/400% of target's maximum health from 35/45/400%.
Chosen Sett now has 30% spell power instead of 400 bonus health.

Active - Showstopper: Grabs his target and slams them forward, dealing 35/45/400% of target's maximum health magic damage to them, and 20/30/200% of the slammed enemy's maximum health magic damage to all other enemies in a large area.
Ability shield and taunt duration increased to 4/4/8 seconds from 4 at all Star-levels.
Active - Shadow Dash: Dashes past his target, shielding himself for 500/800/4000 damage and taunting all adjacent enemies for 4 seconds.
Active - Chain Lash: Lashes his chains out in a 3-hex line, dealing 250/400/600/1000 magic damage to enemies hit and increasing the cost of their next spell by 33%.
Passive - Thick Skin: Takes 15/25/75 reduced post-mitigation damage from all sources.
Ability AD ratio increased to 240/250/275% AD from 200/200/250% AD.
Ability base damage reduced to 85/135/400 from 125/200/600.
Removed: No longer refunds mana on kill.
Removed: No longer invulnerable while leaping.
Ability AD ratio reduced to 200/200/250% AD from 200/225/250% AD.
Ability now targets the champion with the lowest armor instead of the champion who has dealt the highest damage.
Leap time after a successful kill increased.
Ability AD ratio reduced to 200/225/250% AD from 200/225/300% AD.

Active - Truestrike: Stabs his target, striking them for 125/250/600 (+ 200/225/300% AD) physical damage. If this kills them, he becomes unstoppable, untargetable, and invulnerable while he leaps to the enemy who's done the most damage this round and refunds all his mana. This does not apply spell effects.
Chosen Teemo now has 30% spell power instead of 25% mana cost reduction.

Active - Sporecloud Dart: Fires a dart at the enemy with the highest attack speed that explodes into a cloud of spores on contact, poisoning nearby enemies. Poisoned enemies take 200/300/600 magic damage over 2.5/3/4.5 seconds and are blinded for the duration.
Active - Spectral Lantern: Throws his lantern to the lowest-health ally, shielding them and nearby allies for 250/450/750 damage for 4 seconds.
Active - Wild Cards: Throws three cards in a cone that deal 250/350/475 magic damage to each enemy they pass through.
Ability bonus true damage reduced to 50/90/130 from 50/90/140.
Ability bonus true damage increased to 50/90/140 from 40/75/125.
Base attack speed increased to 0.9 from 0.8.
Passive - Silver Bolts: Basic attacks apply a Silver Bolts stack. The third stack consumes all stacks on the target to deal 40/75/125 bonus true damage.
Ability spell power per kill reduced to 1/1/2 from 1/2/4.
Ability target changed to the lowest total-health from lower percent-health.
Ability spell power per kill reduced to 1/2/4 from 1/2/5.
Active - Butterfly Burst: Blasts the enemy with the lowest health, dealing 500/650/1150 magic damage. If this kills the target, he permanently gains 1/2/5 spell power.
Ability armor shred reduced to 40/60/80% from 50/75/100%.
Ability armor shred duration increased to 8 seconds from 6.
Chosen Vi now has 25% mana cost reduction instead of 400 bonus health.
Active - Denting Blow: Blasts through her target, dealing 250/400/600 magic damage to all enemies in a cone and reducing their armor by 50/75/100% for 6 seconds.
Base attack damage increased to 85 from 70.
Base attack speed reduced to 0.8 from 0.9.

New Effect: Gains 135/150/500% bonus attack speed, 50/50/200% lifesteal, and moves faster for the rest of combat. While in this state, if he scores a takedown he howls, granting himself and allies who share a trait with him 60/75/200% bonus attack speed for 3 seconds.

Old Effect: Gains 135/150/500% bonus attack speed, 50/50/200% lifesteal, and moves faster for the rest of combat. While in this state, if he scores a takedown he howls, fearing all adjacent enemies for 0.75/0.75/3 seconds.
Ability stun duration reduced to 0.75/0.75/3 from 1.5/1.5/3.
Ability bonus attack speed reduced to 135/150/500% from 175/200/500%.

Active - Primal Hunger: Gains 175/200/500% bonus attack speed, 50/50/200% lifesteal, and moves faster for the rest of combat. While in this state, if he scores a takedown he howls, fearing all adjacent enemies for 1.5/1.5/3 seconds.
Ability AD ratio increased to 225/265/280% AD from 225/250/275% AD.
Active - Crushing Blow: Slams his target with his staff, basic attacking for 225/250/275% AD physical damage and stunning them for 1.5/2/3 seconds. This does not apply spell effects.
Base attack speed increased to 0.85 from 0.8.
Ability AD ratio increased to 330/340/350% AD from 300/325/350% AD.
New Effect: Xin Zhao sweeps around him, dealing 300/325/350% AD physical damage to nearby enemies and gains 50/60/75 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for the rest of combat.

Old Effect: Modifies his next basic attack to sweep around him, dealing 200/250/350% AD physical damage and Challenging enemies hit for 6 seconds. While an enemy is Challenged, his basic attacks against them deals 200% increased damage, and takes 85% reduced damage from all other sources. This does not apply spell effects.
Ability now goes through basic attack system, meaning it heals from Bloodthirster not Hextech Gunblade, and counts as a single attack for Statikk Shiv and Guinsoo's Rageblade.

Active - Crescent Guard: Sweeps around him, dealing 200/250/350% AD physical damage and Challenging enemies hit for 6 seconds. While an enemy is Challenged, his basic attacks against them deals 200% increased damage, and takes 85% reduced damage from all other sources.
Ability AD ratio increased to 180/200/225% AD from 160/190/225% AD.

Active - Striking Steel: Strikes forward two hexes, basic attacking for 160/190/225% AD physical damage and applying on-hit effects. If he can't hit two targets where he's standing, he'll first dahs to a place where he can. This does not apply spell effects.
Maximum mana increased to to 60 from 50.
Ability resistance reduction reduced to 60% from 90%.
Ability resistance reduction increased to 90% from 60%.
New Effect: Is now untargetable while casting his ability.
Removed: Ability no longer knocks up targets.

Active - Seal Fate: Strikes along a path in front of him, dealing 800/1300/9999 magic damage split between all enemies hit and knocking them up for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit are marked for death, reducing their resistances by 60%. Yone's spell is then replaced with Unforgotten until there are no remaining enemies marked for death.
Unforgotten (20 mana): Dashes to the lowest health enemy that is marked for death, dealing 250/400/1000 magic damage, increased by 0 to 100 for 11.
Ability heal increased to 30/45/75% of target's missing health from 30/45/60%.
Ability bonus attack speed increased to 30/40/60% from 30/40/50%.

Active - Zoomies: Dashes to the lowest-health ally, healing them for 30/45/60% of their missing health and granting them 30/40/50% bonus attack speed for 5 seconds. She then repeats this on the farthest ally.
Ability attack damage steal reduced to 25/30/35% from 30/35/40%.
Base attack speed increased to 0.8 from 0.75.
Ability attack damage steal increased to 30/35/40% from 20/30/40%.
Passive - Contempt for the Weak: Every third attack deals 25/50/75 bonus magic damage and steals 20/30/40% of the target's AD.
Ability can no longer target himself, but can target other Zileans.

Active - Rewind Fate: Places a protective Time Rune on the 2/2/10 allies with the lowest health. When they would die, they instead resurrect after 3.5/3/1 seconds, returning to combat with 350/700/3000 health and shedding all negative effects. After resurrecting, they gain 50% bonus attack speed for the rest of combat.
